lawyer:
Mohammad Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record ------ For the petitioner.

parties:
Md. Lal Miah Petitioners.
Vs.
Md. Anwar Hossain @ Anu ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 5. Mr. Mohammad Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioner submitted that the impugned judgment and order of the High court Division is neither proper nor in accordance with law; that the High Court Division committed an error of law resulting in error in the decision of the case occasioning a failure of justice in misreading the pleadings of the parties as well as the evidence on record and in filling to consider the legal effect of the admitted fact and in basing his decision on mere surmise and conjecture and not on the legal evidence on record; that the High Court Division manifestly erred in law in failing to appreciate that the suit land is homestead land and the petitioner has been owning and possessing the suit land by making house thereon but the defendant-respondent never possess the suit land; that the defendant-respondent never got the possession of the suit land on the basis of the alleged deed of sale and as such, the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division is liable to be set aside.
